corrections.title: Downgrade 3v3 JMK vs Reva to A/53 after observed loss
corrections.rationale: Owner-approved GAC-REVA-JMK1: downgrade the exact 3v3 Jedi Master Kenobi defence versus REVA from S/55 to A/53 after a recent loss, preserve non-provisional status and all other counter/mode identities.

evidence.supports: Owner reports a recent outright loss against Jedi Master Kenobi in 3v3 and approves non-provisional A tier / 53 planning banners.

provenance.conditions: 3v3: Jedi Master Kenobi defence; REVA attacking counter. Full enemy composition, relics, mods, omicrons and datacrons not recorded.
provenance.confidence: Medium for owner-observed failure and explicitly approved reassessment; no statistical win rate is claimed.
provenance.limitations: Single reported loss with unspecified battle conditions. A/53 is a planning estimate for successful wins; it is not a measured mean or a loss result. Distinct 5v5 Reva records are unaffected.

affectedReferences.effect: Only REVA tier S to A, banners 55 to 53, reliability note; BAYLAN row unchanged.
none - checked: 5v5 Reva defence→JMK A/60 preserved.

runtimeImpact.3v3: JMK versus REVA counter changes from S/55 to A/53, remains scored and non-provisional; note discloses loss/reliability.
runtimeImpact.counters: Only 3v3 JMK versus REVA entry changes.
runtimeImpact.roundAvailability: none: counter identity and members unchanged.
runtimeImpact.scoring: Existing A-tier and bannerScore 53 taxonomy; no constants or calculations changed.

counters.notes: Recent recorded loss against Jedi Master Kenobi in 3v3. Counter remains viable but is not sufficiently reliable for S tier.
